note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a KIR 7; A06b KIR 7; L05 Const 24, KIR 8(1)(a)): ordinary naturalisation after 7 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another (with exceptions). Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Kiribati, 2024
sources.said: Ordinarily resident in Kiribati for 7 years (waived if applicant has lost or renounced citizenship). ... Renunciation of citizenship of another country required. ... Person not of i-Kiribati descent who became a citizen on independence day (12 July 1979) but does not renounce foreign citizenship within two years ceases to be Kiribati citizen (Constitution). Person not of I-Kiribati descent who became a citizen after independence day (12 July 1979) loses citizenship if he/she obtains another citizenship by voluntary act (other than marriage) (Citizenship Act).
